URL: https://www.iranintl.com/en/202611232940
Iran International, 23/24 Nov 2026

“The Strait of Hormuz is not a place to test unauthorized routes or ignore maritime warnings,” the IRGC Navy said, warning that vessels disregarding its instructions would be treated as “cooperating with invading forces.”

The statement said one tanker was hit near the southern coast and two others east of the strait while under extensive US military air escort, which it said failed to prevent the incidents.

The claims could not be independently verified.
